'''Sivarra Mecheaux''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived in [[Aurilia]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was the village's [[Medic/Legends|medic]] and was kept busy healing those left wounded from the attacks of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Mellichae]] and his [[Sith Shadows]].

After the village had grown into a township, Sivarra had less work as a medic, so she started selling useful trinkets to adventurers.

==Behind the scenes==
Sivarra Mecheaux was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]]. The game was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]]. She was part of the village of Aurilia where players solved various quests to become a Jedi, but was removed as part of the [[:w:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] of [[2005]], along with Aurilia.

She was brought back into the game with [[:w:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7]] in November [[2007]], along with the new township of Aurilia. She could be found in a medical building, but now served as a vendor where players could buy items with special tokens which could only be acquired by taking part in one of the high-level [[:Wikipedia:Instance dungeon|instance dungeons]] known as "Heroic Encounters".
